evidence: Read instruction.md (5 lines) and all six notes in full, plus seed_data.json. No misspelt word found. Grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder and for other-machine paths (drive letters, /Users/, /home/) over instruction.md, environment/instructions and environment/assets returned nothing; the template's CHANGE_ME lines (template instruction.md:1, notes.md:1) are gone. No duplicated paragraphs or author asides. Cross-file facts agree: instruction.md:3 says 'six notes in /instructions' and exactly six files exist and are copied by environment/Dockerfile:14; seed path /assets/seed_data.json is the same in instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 and both say it holds no starter content, matching seed_data.json:2 ('snippets': []); a single run budget (behaviour.md:5 'five-second run budget'); a single port and start command (integration.md:3); no-sign-in is stated consistently in instruction.md:5, overview.md:3 and policy.md:3; own-editor rule agrees between ui.md:3 and policy.md:3; preview network boundary agrees between security.md:3 and integration.md:5. Two bounded observations, neither a real spelling error nor a demonstrated contradiction: (a) integration.md:7 'Saved snippets, identities and revisions must survive page reloads' uses 'identities' in a product that has 'without sign-in or private accounts' (policy.md:3). The benign reading is snippet record identity (behaviour.md:13 'the same record'), and no test file grades a user identity (grep for 'identit' in task/tests finds nothing), but the word reads like residue from an account-based task and could briefly puzzle a builder. (b) Regional spelling is mixed: 'Colour', 'coloured', 'Colouring' (ui.md:13) and the filename behaviour.md, against 'undo behavior' (ui.md:3) and 'public behavior' (policy.md:5). Both variants are correct spellings; this is only an inconsistency. Tried a broken app that could pass and a conforming app that could fail because of this row's subject matter: found neither, since no wording defect here changes what is built or graded. No runtime measurement is required for this text-only row.
suggested_fix: Optional, in a later candidate: in environment/instructions/integration.md:7 replace 'Saved snippets, identities and revisions' with 'Saved snippets, their record ids and revisions' (or drop 'identities'), and pick one regional spelling, e.g. change 'behavior' to 'behaviour' in ui.md:3 and policy.md:5.
